title: core-bridge relay-event request
description: Payload accepted by POST /functions/v1/core-bridge/relay-event on the meeet core Supabase project (zujrmifaabkletgnpoyw). The bridge forwards an extended copy to the TARS Supabase tars-ingest function. Contract version 1.0.0.

kind.description: Dotted event kind. Convention: <source>.<surface>.<verb>. Lowercase, snake_case segments, at least two segments.

trace_id.description: Opaque trace identifier. Cursor / TARS use the meeet bridge trace_scope id; producers may use any unique string.

session_id.description: Opaque per-session identifier. Frontend conventionally uses ses_<base32>; backend uses ses_internal_*.

contract_version.description: Semver of the producer's TARS event contract. Pinned today at 1.0.0. Bump in lockstep with TARS backend bump and contract docs.

payload.description: Free-form event-specific payload. Additive keys are allowed. Do NOT include PII, raw secrets, full mnemonics, raw API keys, or any field whose name matches /(secret|password|key|token|mnemonic|seed|private)/i unless the producer is the policy gate (which is signed).
